## Install

1. Download **x-cleaner.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` in Chrome, Edge, Brave or Arc and turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
3. Click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder (the one with `manifest.json`).
4. Open x.com signed in, click the X Cleaner icon, and start with a **test run**.

Deletion on X is permanent. Download your archive first (Settings → Your account → Download an
archive of your data) and run the 5-item test before deleting everything.

To check the download: `shasum -a 256 -c x-cleaner-*.zip.sha256`.
